headline: The structure and sizes of the redesign hold in all six looks (Home fits, 802 e2e and axe clean, hit areas clean), but the Receipt screen prints raw member UUIDs, and four behaviours the redesign depends on can be broken without any project test going red. No Blocker.

findings.title: The Receipt screen prints raw member ids (UUIDs) as "who had it"
findings.detail: On a split receipt each item's second line reads `f3e4e98f-969b-435d-89ac-f5d75e457306 · Meals`, and a shared item prints three ids joined by commas. `fake/views.ts` returns `who: db.picks[i.id]`, and since D71 `picks` holds a comma-joined list of member ids, not a name. The redesign kept the line (`receipt.tsx`: `[i.who, i.category].join(" · ")`). screens.md `receipt`: "on a split who had each".

findings.title: Four behaviours the redesign relies on have no test that fails when they break
findings.detail: Each was broken on purpose and the project suite stayed green; a QA test written for the same behaviour went red. (a) Review's one-answer-per-tap guard: `if (pending.current || !settleTap()) return;` replaced by `if (false) return;`; screens.spec "a double tap answers one Review row" still passes, because it clicks the same button twice 20 ms apart, before the next row slides into place. A tap 150 ms later answered two rows (Expected 11, Received 10). (b) Add expense's validation (zero amount, no category) removed: journeys.spec manual 12 passed. (c) The Insights pager's `inert` and `aria-hidden` on cards you are not on removed: journeys insights 12 passed and the B03 axe test passed. (d) Skipped notifications' settle guard removed: no project test taps "This was a payment" at all.
findings.repro: See the probes table. QA's tests: qa/e2e/b04r-r2-tap.spec.ts, b04r-r2-money.spec.ts, b04r-r2-flowsA.spec.ts (FLOW-5), b04r-r2-flowsG.spec.ts (FLOW-33)

findings.title: Button and toggle labels render at 15 px; the spec says 14
findings.detail: `button.tsx` and `toggle.tsx` set `text-label` (14 px), but `cn()` runs tailwind-merge, which does not know `text-label` as a font size, treats it as a text colour and drops it in favour of `text-primary-foreground`. The label inherits the body size. patterns.md §2: "Button labels are 14 px medium at every size". Chips (32 px, secondary level, 13 px text beside them) therefore carry the biggest text on the row.
findings.repro: Review: measure any answer chip's computed font-size

findings.title: Inputs are 15 px; patterns say 16 px so a browser never zooms
findings.detail: Every text input and textarea computes to 15 px (the amount fields are 36 px). patterns.md §2: "Inputs keep 16 px text, so no browser zooms" and §10: "Inputs are at least 16 px". Chrome on Android does not zoom, so this shows only in a browser that does (iOS Safari for the public split page, which a friend opens).

findings.title: Appearance forgets a pinned look when you leave the screen
findings.detail: Choosing a look turns "Change each quarter" off, but that switch is local component state (`useState(true)`). Leave and come back (or reload) and the switch is ON again, the row says "Copper until Fri, 1 Jan 2027" as if it will change, and no look card is chosen. The code comment says the store has no flag yet; the screen still shows a setting it does not keep.
